channel.title: Pier & Point · P11A
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for P11A (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · P11A: The P11A median's map shape cited no sources. It now lists the OCII Dec 2019 Land Use Map (P11A labeled just east of the circle) and the OCII Sept 2023 transition presentation ('P11/11A' among parcels Rec & Park will manage). The summary and map notes said the median sits west of the Parklab Gardens soccer field; OCII's Nov 2024 update puts the SFF soccer field on P12 and Parklab Gardens on P15, so the wording now says the P12 soccer field. 'Already managed' became 'will manage' to match the deck, the P-number note now cites the 2019 map and 2023 deck instead of saying it rested only on our own identification, and the citation to Pier & Point's own mapping notes is labelled as such. The Wikimedia aerial credit names only the Commons username Firstcultural, and the OCII deck's title no longer says 'CAC Item 2' (that came from its file name).
item.description: The P11A median's map shape cited no sources. It now lists the OCII Dec 2019 Land Use Map (P11A labeled just east of the circle) and the OCII Sept 2023 transition presentation ('P11/11A' among parcels Rec & Park will manage). The summary and map notes said the median sits west of the Parklab Gardens soccer field; OCII's Nov 2024 update puts the SFF soccer field on P12 and Parklab Gardens on P15, so the wording now says the P12 soccer field. 'Already managed' became 'will manage' to match the deck, the P-number note now cites the 2019 map and 2023 deck instead of saying it rested only on our own identification, and the citation to Pier & Point's own mapping notes is labelled as such. The Wikimedia aerial credit names only the Commons username Firstcultural, and the OCII deck's title no longer says 'CAC Item 2' (that came from its file name). Source: OCII Mission Bay Land Use Map, 2019-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Att%201%20Mission%20Bay%20Land%20Use%20Map.pdf); OCII, Mission Bay Parks Open Space transition presentation, 2023-09 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Item%202%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Transition.pdf); OCII, Remaining Mission Bay Open Space Parcels Update, Mission Bay CAC, 2024-11-14 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2024-11/Item%205%20-%20Remaining%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Parcels%20Update.pdf).
